interpretation: The support points are convex hulls of source Mesh vertices after serialized body-local transforms; wheel meshes use captured WheelCollider.GetWorldPose plus the exact player child transform. Unity's serialized Mesh records contain no baked convex-cooking bytes, so these are not asserted to equal PhysX's runtime-cooked hulls. A gap below 20 mm is within the two-collider default contact-offset band, not proof of a solver impulse. Negative gap is source-hull penetration only, not measured contact-manifold data.
